articles.title: 'PEACE WAS AN ILLUSION FOR EUROPE', Macron Hints at Upcoming War in the West
articles.description: PARIS, Nov 11 — French President Emmanuel Macron warned on Wednesday that "high-intensity war" has returned to European soil and declared that post-Cold War assumptions of permanent peace were "an illusion," during a pivotal Armistice Day speech in Paris marking 108 years since the end of World War I. Addressing veterans, military officials, and Resistance heroes in what he noted was his final November 11 ceremony in its current form, Macron urged France and Europe to bolster national resilience amid multiplying geopolitical crises and shifting strategic balances. Highlighting that France has doubled its defense budget since 2017, Macron unveiled a four-point reform package to overhaul veteran representation, modernize support for wounded troops, and embed defense and historical remembrance across French schools to strengthen the bond between the armed forces and the nation.

articles.title: Trump's Putin Diesel Deal Hits Roadblock? Russian Tanker Stalls Off US Coast Amid Legal Warnings
articles.description: Trump's surprise diesel deal with Russia has run into trouble after a tanker carrying 40,000 metric tons of Russian fuel slowed to a near standstill off the US East Coast. The Malta-flagged Agioi Fanendes had initially signalled New York as its destination, but the shipment now faces uncertainty amid warnings that Russian energy imports could violate US law. New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill has cautioned ports against accepting the cargo, while lawmakers from both parties have questioned the deal's legality. Despite the controversy, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright insists the diesel will eventually be sold on the global market, even if the tanker heads to another port. The vessel's operator says its final destination has not been decided.
